# BSE-240 companion bundle v2 — 2026-08-19 — Super Mario Sunshine GMSE01 (US)
# Generated by fpspatch.py 240 --bse
#
# WHAT THIS IS
#   The 240fps sibling of bse120-companion-v1.txt, for the BSE FORK kxe
#   (BetterSunshineEngine-highfps-v400.kxe, FPS_240 = enum 3). BSE rewrites the
#   framerate global 0x804167B8 EVERY frame; at FPS_240 it holds float 4.0f
#   (0x40800000), which is why every block in the 120 bundle silently
#   self-disables at 240. Two gating idioms are used:
#     SELF-GATED blocks read 0x804167B8 (or the SDA2 alias) and are inert unless
#       it holds the expected value.
#     GUARDED blocks get a guard prologue (lis/lwz 0x804167B8; cmpw 4.0f; bne ->
#       the block's re-executed original tail) so they run only under FPS_240.
#
# DO NOT ENABLE ALONGSIDE THE BSE-120 COMPANION OR THE STOCK 240 fpspatch BUNDLE.
#   All three hook the SAME addresses. Dolphin installs ONE C2 per address; two
#   codes on one hook is a collision the ==4.0f guard does NOT resolve (the guard
#   runs inside the cave, not at install time). Run exactly one of them.
#
# THERE IS NO "$BSE Force 240 FPS" CODE — BY DESIGN.
#   0x8051E528 is mFPSValue only in the STOCK kxe. The fork kxe shifts its module
#   data and that address is something else there (catalog item 36), so a blind
#   04 write would corrupt an unrelated BSE setting. Use bse_force.py (discovers
#   the fork's mFPSValue by Setting-name scan; fork fallback 0x8051EBA8) or
#   select 240 in BSE's own in-game settings menu. Also set per-game
#   EmulationSpeed = 4.0 (switch_rate.py does all of this in one shot).
#
# v2 CHANGES (2026-08-19, the PC 240 generalization pass)
#   - Animal x4 movement speed / nerve duration REMOVED (never correct under
#     BSE — "mach 10" birds; verdict re-confirmed in-game 2026-08-14).
#   - Bird walk accel ADDED: the needed factor is k = sqrt(FPS/30); 240 has no
#     exact fadds chain (k = sqrt(8) = 2.83), so the block materialises
#     float32(sqrt(8)) through the stack red zone into f30 (provably scratch:
#     the hooked original `fmr f30,f1` overwrites it on every path) and fmuls.
#   - Raw anim-rate: QUARANTINED at 120 (froze water/star/warp anims in-game
#     2026-08-14; BSE natively compensates). DO NOT ENABLE at 240 either.
#
# 120 -> 240 CONSTANT CHANGES (every difference vs the 120 bundle)
#   guard / self-gate literal ..... 0x40000000 (2.0f) -> 0x40800000 (4.0f)
#   30Hz-class divisors FPS/30 .... 4 -> 8   (noki, wipe, SE frame-process)
#   blue-coin keep ratio .......... keep 1-of-4 -> keep 1-of-8
#   game-clock tick shift G ....... >>1 -> >>2
#   raw anim-rate scale 30/FPS .... x0.25 (2 fmuls) -> x0.125 (3 fmuls)
#   shimmer stored ctrl rate ...... 0.25f (3E80) -> 0.125f (3E00)
#   bird walk accel k ............. x2 (one fadds) -> x2.83 (sqrt literal,
#                                   NEEDS-TEST — see v2 CHANGES above)
#   particle parity divisor ....... CONSTANT 2 — UNCHANGED (see caveat below)
#   Poink flyTimer<40 threshold ... CONSTANT 40 — UNCHANGED (spine-tick paced)
#
# CAVEAT — PARTICLE PARITY IS THE ONE UNVERIFIED CONSTANT
#   The parity gate ships at the CONSTANT 1-in-2 per HANDOFF-PC-240 and commit
#   defbcff. That constant is derived from the STOCK kit, where the substep
#   retune pins CUE_CALC_ANIM at ~120 Hz at every G. BSE has no substep retune,
#   and this gate counts gpMarDirector+0x5C — the SAME counter the blue-coin
#   block reads 1-in-(FPS/30) from. If that counter advances once per rendered
#   frame under BSE, the correct 240 divisor is 4, not 2, and 2 runs all JPA at
#   120 Hz instead of 60 (M-portal atoms decomposing 2x FAST). If the playtest
#   shows fast particles, change word 9 of each of the three parity blocks from
#   70600001 to 70600003 (or set BSE_PARITY_DIVISOR to fps // 60 and regenerate).
#
# PER-ITEM TEST STATUS (2026-08-19) — the whole bundle is NEEDS-TEST at 240
#   (the SHAPES are 120-confirmed per the 2026-08-14 A/B; the 4.0f constants
#   and divisor-8 retunes have never run in-game)
#   Particle parity .............. NEEDS-TEST (see the caveat above)
#   Noki 30Hz gate + copy gate ... CRASHES at 120 — DISABLED, do not enable
#   HUD StarFix v4 ............... NEEDS-TEST (rate-independent body)
#   Blue-coin lifetime v6-BSE .... NEEDS-TEST (keep 1-of-8)
#   Wipe pace 30Hz gate .......... NEEDS-TEST (divisor 8)
#   SE frame-process 30Hz gate ... NEEDS-TEST (divisor 8)
#   Game-clock fix v15 ........... NEEDS-TEST (SELF-GATED on 4.0f, ticks >>2)
#   Raw anim-rate x0.125 fixes ... QUARANTINED at 120 — DO NOT ENABLE
#   Bird walk accel x2.83 ........ NEEDS-TEST (sqrt literal; cosmetic risk only)
#   Poink premature-explosion v14  NEEDS-TEST (GUARDED)
#   Heat-haze shimmer pace ....... NEEDS-TEST (SELF-GATED on !=0.5f)
#
# GATING CLASSIFICATION
#   SELF-GATED: game-clock v15 (==4.0f), raw anim-rate (!=0.5f), blue-coin
#     (embedded 4.0f gate), shimmer (!=0.5f).
#   GUARDED (==4.0f prologue): particle parity, noki gate + copy gate, StarFix,
#     wipe pace, SE frame-process, bird walk accel, Poink v14.
#
# 34 C2 blocks; C2 cave usage 454 words / 1816 bytes. Divisors FPS/30 = 8.
#   Verified via fpspatch.py 240 --bse --check (capstone decode + C2 layout law +
#   guard/self-gate presence + divisors + anmrate SDA disp -0x3E8 + fmuls count).
